$comment: Curated on-the-run Treasury notes and bonds — DATA_MODEL §21.1 question 2, §18 module 6.
On-the-run note/bond CUSIPs, coupons and dated dates are in NO recorded fixture: the Treasury
publishes bills with their CUSIPs (treasury-bills.xml) but the yield-curve feed is tenor-keyed
and carries no security identity at all, and there is no auction-results adapter (BRIEF §2).
So these seven securities are curated by hand and this file is their provenance: the seed
writes one `provenance` row for it (source_id 'internal.user', response_sha256 = the sha256 of
these bytes) and every govt_terms version cites it, which is what keeps DATA-10 honest about a
number nobody published.
Fixed by the documents, not by choice: the ticker, coupon, dated and maturity dates of the 2Y,
5Y, 10Y, 20Y and 30Y are the ones FUNCTIONS_TIER3 §0 (L13, L1459-1519) and the committed
SRCH/YAS/DES tests already pin — 'T 4.25 08/15/36 Govt' is the golden 10Y of TESTING §7.3 and of
the rates e2e spec. The 3Y and 7Y appear in no document; their coupons interpolate their
committed neighbours (2Y 3.750 → 5Y 3.875 → 10Y 4.250) and their cycles follow the Treasury's
own calendar (3Y dated and maturing on the 15th, 7Y on the last day of the month).
The CUSIPs are NOT the ones FUNCTIONS_TIER3 L13/L1519 prints. '91282CLM6' (its 10Y),
'91282CLV6' (2Y) and '91282CLW4' (5Y) fail the mod-10 check digit — core/ids/cusip.ts computes
1, 1 and 9 — and `refdata/identifiers.ts` rejects an invalid CUSIP rather than storing one
(REF-02), so a seed that used them would mint seven notes that resolve by no CUSIP at all. The
values below are the check-digit-valid forms of the same bodies, and the 10Y takes '91282CLN9',
the CUSIP the committed YAS integration test already pairs with 'T 4.25 08/15/36'.
asOfNote: The last curve date the September 2026 Treasury captures cover (treasury-xml2, treasury-bills.xml). The seed's provenance row records this as source_ts; valid_from of every version below is midnight UTC of the dated date, because that is when the terms became true in the world.
